candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: For the Blasius laminar boundary layer over a flat plate the streamwise velocity normalized by free-stream velocity (u/U) is a function of a single similarity variable eta = y * sqrt(U/(nu x)). Dimensional analysis with the inputs U (L T^-1), nu (L^2 T^-1), x (L), and y (L) yields the dimensionless group eta = y U^{1/2} nu^{-1/2} x^{-1/2}. Thus u/U = f(eta).

final_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: For the Blasius laminar boundary layer over a flat plate the streamwise velocity normalized by free-stream velocity (u/U) is a function of a single similarity variable eta = y * sqrt(U/(nu x)). Dimensional analysis with the inputs U (L T^-1), nu (L^2 T^-1), x (L), and y (L) yields the dimensionless group eta = y U^{1/2} nu^{-1/2} x^{-1/2}. Thus u/U = f(eta).
